messages:
maria: Quick ask — need a tiny GPU pool in af-south1 for a customer POC (latency to Cape Town). Target: 3x nvidia-a10g (40GB) nodes, mostly for light concurrent inferencing. Can we provision as preemptible/spot with fallback to one reserved node? Any quota/egress constraints I should know about? :eyes:

sam: af-south1 has very low GPU quotas AFAIK; we never requested there before. I can run the quota check now.

infra-bot: /quota-check project=redwood-prod region=af-south1
Result: GPU count quota = 0, GPUs used = 0, quota available = 0. Estimated cloud support SLA for quota increase ~72h.
Network: NAT IPs reserved in af-south1 = 2/2 (no spare).

lee: Two quick options:
1) Short-term hack: one dedicated A10G in a region with existing quota and cross-region routing — painful for latency.
2) Recommended: small "burst" spot pool in af-south1 + 1 non-spot fallback in another region. Use taints/affinity so only POC pods land on af-south1. Autoscaler config maxNodes=4, min=0.

anika: Notes: preemptible nodes = model cache lost on eviction. Add startup script to pre-download model and healthcheck. Also set low PDB for POC so CA can evict quickly.

maria: ok — can someone paste a nodePool spec snippet I can copy into the infra PR? :+1:

lee: sure, paste below:
```
apiVersion: container/v1
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: af-south1-a10g-burst
spec:
  autoscaling:
    minNodeCount: 0
    maxNodeCount: 4
  machineType: nvidia-a10g-40gb
  preemptible: true
  taints:
    - key: workloads/poc
      value: true
      effect: NoSchedule
  nodeLabels:
    workload-type: poc
    region: af-south1
  startupScript: |
    #!/bin/bash
    # warm model cache on boot
    mkdir -p /models && gsutil cp gs://redwood-models/poc/a10g-model.tar.gz /models/ || true
    tar -xzf /models/a10g-model.tar.gz -C /models || true
```

sam: add these CA annotations and flags on the nodepool/controller: `cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/safe-to-evict=true`, `--scale-down-unneeded-time=1m`, `--expander=least-waste`. Helps reclaim spot nodes faster.

maria: rough cost estimate for POC?

lee: rough ballpark: spot A10G ~ $0.9/hr (varies) -> 3 * $0.9 * 24 ~ $65/day if fully used. NAT IP + egress ~ small incremental (depends on data). One reserved A10G (non-preemptible) would be closer to $3/hr -> adds ~$72/day.

anika: I'll open cloud support ticket for GPU quota increase and request expedited review. Tagging cloud-quota channel.

maria: thanks — if quota doesn't come through in 48h we fallback to hosting POC in us-east and simulate latency. :thumbsup:

lee: add routing policy so requests prefer af-south1 when nodes are up, otherwise route to us-east. Also include canary pin for model version so we don't impact other customers. :lock:
